title: Gold after a yen surge day

rule.signal: USD/JPY daily return beyond 1.5 x the sd of the 20 returns before the day (surge = USD/JPY down, slump = up)
rule.costs: $0.60 a trade + nights() x FIN.xau.long on buys

tests.what: yen surge (USD/JPY down > 1.5 sd): buy gold, hold 3 days (primary)
yen slump (USD/JPY up > 1.5 sd): sell gold, hold 3 days
yen surge (USD/JPY down > 1.5 sd): buy gold, hold 1 day
